caption: Saying “hello” to my AI cost 4,400 tokens.
Free AI services have daily limits. When one runs out, your chat stops.
So I built a front desk. It sends each message to whichever free service is open.
Private or work questions? They stay on my laptop.
Two commands to set up. One to add a provider.
On my setup: 15 of 15 checks passed. Fallback tested.
Free guide + scripts: link in the comments.
